title: MiSCHiEF: A Benchmark in Minimal-Pairs of Safety and Culture for Holistic Evaluation of Fine-Grained Image-Caption Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) using the MiC (Minimal-pairs in Culture) dataset, requiring models to correctly match contrastive minimal-pair image and caption sets that differ only by specific cultural proxies like food, clothing, holidays, and architecture.

Assessing cross-modal alignment using contrastive image-caption pairs where the minimal change involves racial or ethnic identity keywords and corresponding visual features, testing for accurate visual grounding free of stereotypes.
Testing the model's ability to accurately ground and distinguish between minimal-pair image-caption sets that substitute specific religious activities, sacred symbols, or belief systems.
Evaluating model performance on tasks like Caption-to-Image and Image-to-Caption matching where the only differentiating factor in the minimal pair is the specified country or geographic context.
